name: deep-review
description: Verification-gated multi-agent code review. Reviews look past the diff, prove each finding before reporting it, and can fix, report, or comment on a PR with a verdict. Optional scheduled task reviews PRs you're requested on and follows up when authors respond.

approval_mode.title: Approval mode
approval_mode.description: What comment mode does when a PR has no blocking findings. never: leave a comment-only review and approve yourself. confirm: ask you first; unattended runs leave the approval to you. automatic: approve. An approval is recorded as your review.

block_at.title: Request changes at
block_at.description: Lowest verified severity that makes comment mode request changes. Findings below it are posted as non-blocking comments.

review_requests.title: Review requested PRs automatically
review_requests.description: Let the scheduled task deep-review PRs where you are directly requested as a reviewer. Follow-up rounds on PRs you already deep-reviewed run either way.

clones_root.title: Folder with your local clones
clones_root.description: Automatic reviews only run on repositories cloned directly under this folder.
